anomalies.description: The navigation and document title use "Unlock Vendor", while the in-page scanner heading uses "Unlock Route For Driver".
anomalies.evidence: The same live page showed title "Scan | Unlock Vendor | Rx2Go" and panel text "Scanner | Unlock Route For Driver".
anomalies.impact: QA automation and documentation may need to account for inconsistent Vendor, Driver, and Route terminology.

anomalies.description: The Off and On options are exposed as generic clickable labels rather than semantically named radio buttons or switches.
anomalies.evidence: The accessibility snapshot represented both options as generic nodes, and DOM inspection found LABEL elements without role or aria-checked attributes.
anomalies.impact: Accessibility and stable role-based selector coverage are limited for this control.

uncertainties: The actual unlock submission was not exercised because no safe QA barcode or vendor/route context was available.
The module-specific submission endpoint, request method, response fields, success state, and error states were not triggered.
It was not proven whether Auto Submit state persists across reloads or sessions.
It was not proven whether changing facility or hub changes the eligible barcode/vendor/route context.
No valid-barcode, invalid-barcode, duplicate-scan, locked-route, or already-unlocked validation behavior was safely observable.
result.summary: ADM currently exposes the verified Scan | Unlock Vendor route at /scanner/unlock-for-driver. Its read-only observed surface is a barcode input under "Scanner | Unlock Route For Driver" plus an Off/On Auto Submit control, initially On. Facility and hub context are present, but the business unlock action and its API could not be safely exercised without a valid QA barcode and associated context.
